findings.claim: PR #338 splits into a disjoint green GH #333 pair (57eb632, bd63317) and a GH #336 pair (b902dc5, d637b21) overlapping Phase 225 plan Phases 1-3.

Two CI failures root-cause to _EVIDENCE_STMT_RE's observed group [^
]* capturing the closing backtick of one-span statements; true statements flag evidence-not-reproducible. Verified by execution.
One CI failure: TRUTH_CHECKED_KINDS changed without amending the doctrine; ceiling test fires exactly as VETO F1 predicted.
Two CI failures: legacy fixtures newly adjudicated under an unstated ref-prefixed citation-key contract; one fixture is live-state-coupled and broke when the PR shifted module lines.
PR Citation Lint failure is structural enforcement of the governed cycle (missing plan path, ledger ref, Merkle seal), not a code defect.
Dominant defect (VETO F3) unfixed in both vehicles: two-span corpus style parses to no match; the doctrine's mandated no-NN form is unparseable by construction. Verified by execution.
Governed Phase 225 cycle carries #336 as plan iteration 2 per VETO F1-F6 with statement grammar as primary deliverable; salvage the #333 pair; supersede #338's #336 pair.
